final_message:
Blog slugs now keep the base letter of accented characters: "Crème brûlée recipes" becomes `creme-brulee-recipes`. `npm test` passes all 3 tests.

The fix is in `src/blog/slug.js`. Before calling the vendored `slugify`, it decomposes accented characters and drops the combining marks. The vendored copy is slugify 1.2.0, which strips non-ASCII letters. Its changelog says 1.2.1 transliterates them instead. I didn't touch `vendor/`. The proper fix is for the platform team to upgrade to 1.2.1, after which this workaround could be removed.

`src/shop/product-url.js` also calls the vendored `slugify` directly, so product URLs still drop accents. I left it alone because you asked for blog URLs only. The same workaround would work there if you want it.

I haven't committed anything.
